name: GET /api/dialer/dispositions - The call disposition taxonomy
description: Lists every disposition an AI call can end with and what it means to the dialer: {code, reached, retryable, crm_disposition, description}. Retryable outcomes (no_answer, busy, voicemail, failed) are retried under the campaign retry policy; reached ones close the contact. opt_out is automated (e6ae5703-37a6-4d27-a7d5-23ec80c4a001#AC4 — an opt_out disposition writes suppression and revokes consent): when a call ends with it the number gets a tenant-scoped voice suppression (reason optout) so the DNC gate refuses later calls, the person's ai_voice_outbound consent receipts for this tenant are revoked so the consent gate refuses too, and voice.call.opted_out.v1 is audited; repeating the end-of-call report changes nothing.
